ocl.definition: staff:Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o | o.Id = id), boss:Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o | o.Id = bossid)
ocl.postcondition: let newStaff:Staff in (newStaff.oclIsNew() and newStaff.Id = id and newStaff.Name = name and newStaff.Password = pswd and newStaff.Phone = phone and newStaff.Role = role and newStaff.Boss = boss and Staff.allInstance()->includes(newStaff)) and result = newStaff.oclIsNew()
